rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and one-to-one join key; mandatory for referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier and primary key candidate; duplicates would break one-to-one relationships

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N; every record must have a matching counterpart in the related table

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028; must be stored as string and conform to exactly 4 digits

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is mandatory personal identification information

rule: Name must use Title Case convention (flag all-lowercase or all-uppercase words)
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic casing deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase) deviate from the dominant Title Case pattern

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID number is mandatory for identity verification

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one uppercase letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values conform to pattern aXXXXXXXa; anomalies detected include 6-digit format and missing prefix

rule: ID_No must not contain sentinel test values
rationale: Value 'F0000000X' detected with all-zero digit pattern indicating test/sentinel data

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows three semantic categories with case inconsistencies; standardizing to Title Case canonical set

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female
rationale: Binary classification field with case inconsistencies; standardizing to Title Case canonical values

rule: Age must be numeric parseable (no text values like 'Twenty-five')
rationale: Column contains non-numeric text entry 'Twenty-five' that cannot be parsed as a number

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age; flags negative values and unrealistic high ages

rule: Age below 13 may be unrealistic for a service account context
rationale: Evidence indicates values 4 and -5 present; service accounts typically require adult customers

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is mandatory for customer communication; evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 records)

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8 digits
rationale: Singapore-based dataset with country code +65; valid numbers are 8 digits starting with 6, 8, or 9

rule: Contact_No must follow standard international format '+65 XXXXXXXX' or local 8-digit format
rationale: Evidence shows inconsistent formatting: '+65 XXXXXXXX', '65 XXXXXXXX', and 'XXXXXXXX'; 7-digit value '8964359' appears truncated

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is mandatory contact information for customer accounts

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 4 malformed values: missing @, containing space, or double @

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore'
rationale: Evidence shows 8 variations of Singapore (multilingual, abbreviations, case variants); canonical form is Title Case English

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is mandatory component of address

rule: Street_Name must not be in all uppercase (e.g., 'HOLLAND ROAD')
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic casing deviation: 'HOLLAND ROAD' uses all caps while dominant pattern is Title Case

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits; evidence shows 4-digit and 5-digit values (6907, 99999) indicating missing leading zeros or invalid formats

rule: Name particles must be consistent with Gender: 'Bin' or 's/o' indicates Male; 'Binte' or 'd/o' indicates Female
rationale: Malay patronymics (Bin/Binte) and Indian relational suffixes (s/o/d/o) encode gender; flag contradictions with Gender column

check_params.logic: ((re.search(r'\bBin\b', str(row['Name'])) or re.search(r'\bs/o\b', str(row['Name']))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or ((re.search(r'\bBinte\b', str(row['Name'])) or re.search(r'\bd/o\b', str(row['Name']))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: If Country is Singapore (in any form), Postal_Code must be 6 digits
rationale: Singapore addresses require 6-digit postal codes; validates consistency between geographic fields

check_params.logic: str(row['Country']).lower() in ['singapore', 'singapura', 'sg', "s'pore", 'republic of singapore', '新加坡'] and len(str(row['Postal_Code'])) != 6

rule: Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Account_No appears in both tables linked by S_N; values must be consistent across the one-to-one relationship

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No values must match between tables for the same S_N

rule: ID_No must match the corresponding ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (case-insensitive)
rationale: National ID appears as ID_No in this table and ID in Acc_Info_dirty; must be identical for the same customer

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must match ID between tables for the same S_N (case-insensitive)

rule: Name must match the corresponding Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (case-insensitive, allowing for completeness)
rationale: Customer name appears as Name in this table and Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty; discrepancies indicate data quality issues (e.g., 'Danish' vs 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin')

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name between tables for the same S_N (case-insensitive)

rule: Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['F1011121T'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['thm@example.com'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.
